description: This PHP source file defines the class Kint_Decorators_Rich, which provides methods for decorating and rendering variable data and trace information for debugging purposes, including HTML output generation.

classes.name: Kint_Decorators_Rich
classes.description: A class providing static methods for decorating variable data and trace information into HTML format for debugging.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Generates HTML output for a variable, including extended values and alternatives.

methods.name: decorateTrace
methods.description: Generates HTML output for a backtrace array.

methods.name: wrapStart
methods.description: Returns opening HTML tags for a dump.

methods.name: wrapEnd
methods.description: Returns closing HTML tags and callee info for a dump, including optional trace display.

methods.name: _drawHeader
methods.description: Creates HTML header for a variable, including type, name, and access level.

methods.name: _ideLink
methods.description: Creates an HTML link to the IDE or file path for a given file and line.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Produces CSS and JS required for display, only once per page load.
